items.title: Attorney General Blanche Honors Goodyear Police Officer Dakota Berry for Distinguished Service
items.summary: WASHINGTON – Goodyear Police Officer Dakota Berry was among the law enforcement officers from around the nation who were selected to be honored by U.S. Attorney General Todd Blanche today for Distinguished Service in Policing.

items.title: ADA Settlement Requires Accessibility Improvements at Cochran-Bleckley Recreation Department
items.summary: MACON, Ga. – The Cochran-Bleckley Recreation Department has agreed to make accessibility improvements across its facility following an investigation by the U.S. Attorney's Office into allegations that certain areas were not readily accessible to or usable by individuals with disabilities, as required by the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA).

items.title: District of Arizona Charges 314 Individuals for Immigration-Related Criminal Conduct this Week
items.summary: PHOENIX, Ariz. – During the week of enforcement operations from Nov. 14 through Nov. 20, 2026, the U.S. Attorney’s Office for the District of Arizona brought immigration-related criminal charges against 314 individuals.
